source_note: See data/wow_spells/README.md for the schema. Every entry's values are read live from its own WoW: Forever Wowhead spell tooltip (wowhead.com/forever/spell=<wowhead_spell_id>) unless "notes" says otherwise. This file covers only the Balance single-target rotation pieces reachable in an 11-point level-20 build, like the Mage/Rogue/Priest passes.
gaps: Starfire, Insect Swarm, Moonkin Form and the full Feral/Restoration trees not looked up.

Talents' exact numeric effects not looked up (only names/point allocation confirmed from the real build): Improved Wrath (cast time + Mana cost reduction, per Icy Veins' text), Moonglow, Nature's Reach (hit chance + range, per Icy Veins' text), Improved Moonfire.

Real level-20 build note: the guide explicitly frames the last point (Improved Moonfire, taken as 1/2 rather than maxed) as "extremely flexible" -- i.e. not a firmly fixed pick the way the other 10 points are. Worth remembering this build is slightly softer at the margin than Warrior/Mage/Rogue/Priest's fully-determined 11-point builds.

Note on "resource_system" above: it's "mana" for Balance specifically. Feral (added 2026-09-25, see talents.feral and the Claw/Rip/Maul abilities below) uses Energy in Cat Form and Rage in Bear Form -- this project's schema declares one resource per file, so each Feral ability's own real resource_cost key (energy/rage) is what actually matters, not this top-level field.

Feral (2026-09-25): real, sourced finding -- Wowhead's own "Level 20 Feral Druid DPS" guide calls the level-20 kit "fairly lackluster... only having two damage abilities in Claw and Rip", confirming Icy Veins' own simpler framing. Cat Form's real rotation: Claw (builder) until 4+ combo points on a target expected to live >=6s, then Rip (finisher) -- this exact 4-CP threshold (not 5) is Wowhead's own guide text, more precise than Icy Veins' generic "5 combo points". Bear Form's real rotation only sources Maul (a next-swing damage enhancer, real classic mechanic) -- Enrage (Rage generator) and Swipe (AoE) are real but not sourced this pass (Enrage's own numbers weren't pinned down; Swipe is an AoE tool, out of scope for single-target). Growl (taunt) and Demoralizing Roar are real Bear tools with no simulated-damage relevance.

abilities.notes: Rank 3 is the max rank trainable by level 20 (Rank 4 requires level 22). Real single-target priority (Icy Veins): filler damage once Moonfire is already active on the target.

Rank 3 is the max rank trainable by level 20 (Rank 4 requires level 22). Real, sourced Arcane school (not Nature) despite being a "lunar fire" spell -- don't assume school from flavor. The tooltip's own "DoT Stacking Rule" flag is a direct, explicit confirmation of this schema's general non-stacking-on-refresh rule (see README.md), not just an inference. Real single-target priority (Icy Veins): keep this active on the target at all times, ahead of Wrath.

Exactly the level-20 cap (Cat Form itself is unlocked by a level-20 class quest). Cat Form's real combo-point builder: 110% weapon damage + 27 flat, awards 1 combo point (tooltip text; the raw effect value shows 2, tooltip text used as authoritative per this project's standing rule). Real GCD is 1 second, same as Rogue's (not the 1.5s default).

Exactly the level-20 cap. Real per-combo-point DoT table from the tooltip (not derived): 1 CP 44 over 12s, 2 CP 71, 3 CP 97, 4 CP 124, 5 CP 150 (6 ticks of ~2s each). Real, explicit "DoT Stacking Rule" flag confirms the schema's non-stacking-on-refresh default. Real single-target priority (Wowhead's own Level 20 Feral Druid DPS guide, more precise than Icy Veins' generic text): cast at 4+ combo points if the target will live at least ~6 more seconds, otherwise keep using Claw. Also scales with Attack Power per the tooltip's own text; exact coefficient not shown in the effect breakdown (gap, same as Rogue's Eviscerate).

Real level-10 rank (well below the level-20 cap, already usable). Bear Form's real Rage-spender: enhances the next melee swing by a flat +18 damage (tooltip text; raw effect value shows 19). No GCD -- queues onto the next swing rather than consuming an action, the same real mechanic as Warrior's Heroic Strike. Real single-target priority (Icy Veins): the main Rage dump while tanking single targets (Swipe is the AoE alternative, out of scope here).

balance.notes: Real level-20 build takes 5/5 (reduces Wrath's cast time and Mana cost, per Icy Veins' text; exact per-rank amounts not looked up). Picked over Nature's Focus (Restoration, pushback resistance) as the guide's stated first choice.
Real level-20 build takes 3/3 ("reduces the amount of time you'll spend not casting spells", per Icy Veins -- likely a Mana-cost reduction; exact effect not looked up).
Real level-20 build takes 2/2 (reduces spell miss chance and increases range, per Icy Veins' text; exact per-rank amounts not looked up).
Real level-20 build takes only 1/2 -- explicitly called "extremely flexible" by Icy Veins, the softest pick in this build (unlike every other class's fully-determined 11 points found so far).

feral.effect_per_rank: -Rage cost of Bear Form abilities per rank; -Energy cost of Cat Form abilities per rank
feral.notes: Real level-20 build takes 5/5 -- helps both Bear (more Maul casts) and Cat (cheaper Claw) resource economy, per Icy Veins' text.

feral.effect_per_rank: +15%/rank movement speed in Cat Form; +Dodge chance per rank in all forms
feral.notes: Real level-20 build takes 2/2 -- mobility/survivability, not a damage talent.

feral.effect_per_rank: +Intellect/Stamina/Strength (form-dependent) per rank, per Icy Veins' text
feral.notes: Real level-20 build takes 3/5 -- Icy Veins notes it's "very potent at higher levels, but a bit less so with low level gear", i.e. a real but currently-weak pick.

feral.effect_per_rank: Grants a Charge-like gap-closer usable in Bear/Cat Form
feral.notes: Real level-20 build takes 1/1, the build's final point -- mobility, not a sustained-damage tool (same out-of-scope reasoning as Warrior's Charge).
